title: UI audit remainder — selected native evidence
status: Selected captures are actual emulator observations pinned to their exact source revisions. Final product source is a705c23. Captures 127–130 are pinned to 8f4f7f4, immediately before the final App Info Email-label copy change; their recovery code was unchanged. Source/docs Sol addendum review remains pending; no PR has been created.
captureNotes: This curated set contains only named PNG/XML pairs copied from the durable ignored runtime/captures directory. JSON sidecars, raw logs, setup/login images, screenshots with token-bearing URLs, and failed ANR screenshots are excluded. Values below retain source revision and file hashes, viewport, theme, font scale, fixture role/state and request counters. All data was disposable local fixture data.
